_doc: Traffic and pedestrians (spec sim.md §5-§6, Roadcraft src/sim/**). Anti-gridlock (traffic/junctions.ts, micro.ts, regions.ts): jam_seconds/release_every_s jammed-junction release, starve_seconds exit claim, detour_after_s detour at a full exit, reconsider_* route reconsideration in a full queue, bpr_gain congestion cost, tail_credit_* room a moving tail frees, gov_* fleet governor. Pedestrians (peds.ts): trips of ped_trip_min_m..max_m between nodes; they cross arms along the middle of the painted zebra and vehicles stop behind the stop line (both from data/catalog/street_furniture.json crossing), walkers step off only with ped_critical_gap_s to spare and give a vehicle standing ped_courtesy_s its turn; ped_span_reach_m = heavy half width + 0.9 m either side of a lane. Crowd (Roadcraft 4.0 walk.ts, SUMO striping): the footway in ped_stripe_m stripes ped_margin_m off its edges; a walker looks ped_look_m ahead, takes the stripe with the most room (ped_lateral_cost per metre aside, ped_keep_right_cost per metre off its own track, a better one only ped_stripe_gain_m better and after ped_stripe_hold_s), steps aside at ped_lateral_share of its pace and keeps ped_gap_m plus ped_headway_s behind a body of radius ped_body_m (ped_accel to speed up again). The same stripes everywhere they walk: each walker sees every body near it (walkers in any mode, the street furniture's footprints) remapped into its own way's frame (SUMO's walking areas), on a sidewalk, round a corner (as wide either side of its line as the sidewalk it heads for, closing toward a place it must reach as fast as it steps aside, the leftmost ped_reserve_share up to ped_reserve_max_m left to those coming the other way: SUMO's reserve-oncoming on walking areas) and over a zebra (its right half only); a body moving slower than ped_moving_ms (under a body's width in 4 s) stands, one heading against its own way comes the other way; held ped_jam_s (SUMO's jamtime on crossings) it squeezes past walkers (never furniture) at ped_jam_share of its pace (SUMO: a quarter). At a crosswalk the waiting stand on their own right half of the zebra, kerb_wait_gap_m apart within kerb_wait_half_m of its middle, in up to kerb_wait_rows rows back from the kerb (as many as leave a way along the sidewalk), step forward when a place ahead frees and cross from that place. Read by native/src/api/traffic_loader.cpp into TrafficParams. Distances in metres, times in seconds, speeds in m/s unless the key says km/h.
